block.text: **🔵 Blue Colony — Non-Recombinant:** The lacZ gene in this cell is _intact_ (no insert was cloned into the MCS). β-galactosidase is expressed and cleaves X-gal in the medium, producing a blue compound. This clone does NOT contain the gene of interest.

**⚪ White Colony — Recombinant ✓:** An insert has been cloned into the MCS, disrupting the lacZ gene. β-galactosidase is non-functional and cannot cleave X-gal — so the colony remains white. This clone MAY contain the gene of interest (confirm by PCR/sequencing).
